items.title: Baker Hughes (BKR) Secures LNG And Gas Turbine Orders Across Key Growth Markets
items.summary: Baker Hughes (NasdaqGS:BKR) received a major order from Venture Global LNG for a comprehensive liquefaction solution to support an LNG expansion project in Louisiana. The company also secured an order from Dynamis Power Solutions for NovaLT™16 gas turbines, aimed at modular, high-availability power solutions for data centers and the oil & gas sector. items.title: Basin rig count up three as prices drop
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up three this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 263 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 256 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is unchanged from last week at 588 rigs. A year ago, 539 rigs were active.
